description.value: A family-owned, 25-room motel on Highway 5 in Barriere, BC, operated by the Blanke family since 1995 and positioned roughly halfway between Vancouver and Jasper—making it a natural overnight stop on a long-distance touring route. The property offers entry-level, wheelchair-accessible rooms, an on-site laundromat, and BBQ and picnic tables outdoors. It sits adjacent to the Station House Restaurant and close to a Petro-Canada with A&W take-out.

address.value: 4830 Yellowhead South Highway (British Columbia Highway 5), Barriere, BC V0E 1E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail across multiple subpages. The address listed on the website ('4830 Yellowhead South Highway') differs from the OSM tag ('4380 Southern Yellowhead Highway') consistently across all pages, so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or e-bike charging appears anywhere on the site; laundry, adjacent restaurant, and free Wi-Fi are all explicitly confirmed by the website.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM has '4380 Southern Yellowhead Highway' but the website consistently shows '4830 Yellowhead South Highway (British Columbia Highway 5)' across all pages — the house number digits appear transposed in OSM. Website value used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with a functioning website and clear evidence of being open year-round; a logical overnight stop for cyclists touring Highway 5.

Laundry.detail: On-site laundromat confirmed: 'We have an on-site laundromat so you can wash your clothes' (guest-services page); also listed as 'Guest laundromat' on the rooms page

Nearby evening food.detail: Station House Restaurant is adjacent to the motel: 'Guests may also enjoy a delicious meal in the adjacent licensed family restaurant – the Station House Restaurant.'
